fields.PRODUCT NAME: Azure Blossom Hand block Cushion Cover
fields.DESCRIPTION: Infuse your home with vibrant artistry through our Azure Blossom Hand block Cushion Cover. Adorned with bold blue floral motifs and delicate leafy patterns, this 16x16 inch piece showcases the timeless beauty of traditional hand block printing. The striking contrast of vivid blue on a soft background makes it an eye-catching addition to sofas, chairs, or bedrooms.
